advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure `--repair-snapshots --dry-run` plan lines are represented (or intentionally documented as excluded) in `--output json`.
evidence: `m = re.match(r"^([A-Z_]+):\s*(.*)$", line)` then `if not m: continue` (fsck.py:459-461)
repair_or_plan returns `f"DRY-RUN: would rebuild SNAPSHOT for {ticket_id}"` / `f"DRY-RUN: would SKIP {ticket_id} — ..."` (fsck_repair.py:591-595)
the new test asserts only text: `assert "DRY-RUN" in res.stdout` (test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py)
advisory.finding: The `DRY-RUN:` plan lines emitted by `repair_or_plan` are silently dropped from `fsck --output json` because the JSON classifier regex `^([A-Z_]+):` does not match the hyphen in `DRY-RUN`, so the previewed plan (would-rebuild / would-skip) is invisible in JSON output even though it appears in text.
scenarios: An operator runs `rebar fsck --repair-snapshots --dry-run --output json` to preview the broad legacy rebuild programmatically and receives no plan entries.
